summary: Tested NEW 'Purchase History from SAP' panel on Suppliers page (real posted Supplier Invoices via QuerySupplierInvoiceQueryIn SOAP service) plus light regression on previously-passed features. All new feature scenarios and regression checks passed.

issues: SAP call is slow (~30-40s) before table/data renders after clicking Load; loading state text 'Reading from SAP...' shown correctly during this time so it's not a hang, just a UX latency consideration given known flaky/slow SAP tenant infra - not a bug, just noting for awareness

critical_code_review_comments: sap_supplier_invoice_client.py: rows are not deduplicated (documented intentionally, matches real SAP duplicate line entries) - verified duplicate rows are genuine (small counts, e.g. 2-4 dup per invoice), not an infinite loop/parsing bug.
GET /api/suppliers/sap-purchase-history/{product_id} correctly returns 200 with empty list [] for unknown product IDs rather than erroring - good defensive handling.
Frontend panel correctly distinguishes SAP (blue badge) vs ERP (pink badge) styling, matches spec.
test_credentials: SAP Write page passcode: 'admin' (as documented, no other creds needed)
seed_data_creation: None - used real data (SCR415WM, SCR410WM, ZZZFAKE123 fake ID)
context_for_next_testing_agent: New SAP Purchase History panel fully verified via UI+API: SCR415WM shows SUAKSI HARDWARES @0.15 INR and KGN HARDWARE & FASTENERS @0.18-0.19 INR (close to spec's ~0.19); SCR410WM shows 'No Released purchasing price on file in SAP' warning plus real invoices from KGN HARDWARE & FASTENERS @0.19 INR - exactly matching the business use-case described. Empty state for fake product ID (ZZZFAKE123) renders cleanly with correct data-testid=sap-purchase-history-empty text. Regression pass confirmed: Admin dropdown (Component Master + SAP Write links), SAP Write page passcode gate + write/read forms, Inventory Entity filter (RADISH TECHNOLOGIES/RAY INTERNATIONAL, filters 3180->2395 items correctly). Purchasing Plan page loaded fine with Admin dropdown visible, did not fully regenerate a plan (not required per light-regression scope, no reason to suspect this session's changes touched that page). Note: SAP responses take 30-40s to return in this session (both live existing-price-specs and new purchase-history calls) - consistent with the known pre-existing SAP tenant intermittent slowness/flakiness mentioned in task context; did not need retry as it eventually succeeded within a single wait window.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this round of testing
